create_series_from_sequence: create a Polars Series from a Python sequence with optional dtype and strict mode
build_series_from_iterable: build a Polars Series from an iterable or generator with chunked processing
create_series_from_numpy: create a Polars Series from a NumPy array with automatic dtype inference
build_series_from_pandas: build a Polars Series from a pandas Series or DatetimeIndex via Arrow conversion
create_series_from_arrow: create a Polars Series from an Arrow array with optional rechunking and dtype casting
